battle.name: 四帝內戰
battle.theater: 多瑙河畔卡農圖姆至薩洛納
battle.brief: 公元306年，羅馬帝國在戴克里先退位後出現四帝並立。馬克西米努斯·特拉克斯在意大利與元老院決裂，加利里烏斯聯君士坦提烏斯自東方回師，七月十一日在潘諾尼亞的卡農圖姆擊潰前者，迫其退守阿奎萊亞。卡面的亞述長弓出自公元前八世紀，戰場上拉弓的是薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭人的複合反曲弓。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場內戰爆發於公元306年的羅馬帝國，是戴克里先改革之後的體制第一次整體失控。帝國此時名義上由四人分治：兩位奧古斯都是馬克西米努斯·特拉克斯與加利里烏斯，兩位凱撒是君士坦提烏斯·克洛魯斯與加利里烏斯·瓦列里安·馬克西米安努斯。馬克西米努斯在304年3月即帝位，是第一位沒有任何家世背景、全憑軍功與宮廷奪位登上皇帝位置的人；加利里烏斯自293年起與叔父戴克里先共治，305年成為東方的唯一奧古斯都，掌著敘利亞、埃及與多瑙河下游的駐軍與稅源。凱撒一級則各自統率輔助兵與邊防部隊：君士坦提烏斯是駐不列顛的總督，馬克西米安努斯以西班牙與北非的軍權為基地。306年2月1日，馬克西米努斯把君士坦提烏斯晉升為奧古斯都，加利里烏斯也把馬克西米安努斯晉升到同級，四帝共治於是變成兩對奧古斯都的對峙。直接交手的兩方，是占據意大利的馬克西米努斯一方，與自東方回師的加利里烏斯、君士坦提烏斯、馬克西米安努斯聯軍。馬克西米努斯的班底是禁衛軍、由萊茵與多瑙河前線徵調的日耳曼輔助兵，以及他自行招引的外族援軍：他與薩珊波斯的「萬王之王」沃洛加斯達成協議，阿蘭與羅克索拉尼等薩爾馬提亞部族大批渡過多瑙河，進入默西亞與色雷斯。聯軍一方則握有帝國正規野戰軍的骨幹、元老院的支持，以及君士坦提烏斯從不列顛帶回來的部隊。值得注意的是，306年的羅馬境內至少有五條戰線同時在動：意大利、多瑙河下游、不列顛、西班牙的馬克西米安努斯，以及波斯邊境；而羅馬本部只有一位皇帝能同時支配所有這些資源，這正是內戰的根源。
countriesEn: This civil war broke out in the Roman Empire in AD 306, the first time the whole structure created by Diocletian went out of control. The empire was nominally divided four ways: two Augusti, Maximinus Thrax and Galerius, and two Caesars, Constantius Chlorus and Galerius Valerius Maximianus. Maximinus had taken the throne in March 304, the first emperor in Roman history to reach the purple with no family background at all, on nothing but military service and a palace coup; Galerius had co-ruled with his uncle Diocletian since 293 and after 305 was the sole Augustus in the East, holding the garrisons and the tax income of Syria, Egypt and the lower Danube. The Caesars commanded the auxiliary and frontier troops in their own right: Constantius was governor of Britain, while Maximianus based himself on the military authority of Spain and North Africa. On 1 February 306 Maximinus raised Constantius to the rank of Augustus, and Galerius raised Maximianus to the same grade, so that the Tetrarchy became a confrontation between two pairs of Augusti. The parties that actually fought were Maximinus's side, which held Italy, and the coalition of Galerius, Constantius and Maximianus returning from the East. Maximinus's strength was the Praetorian Guard, the Germanic auxiliaries he had drawn from the Rhine and the Danube front, and foreign auxiliaries he had recruited himself: he reached an agreement with Vologaes, the Sassanian King of Kings, and large bodies of the Alan and Roxolani Sarmatian peoples crossed the Danube into Moesia and Thrace. The coalition held the backbone of the imperial field army, the support of the Senate, and the troops Constantius brought back from Britain. It is worth noticing that at least five fronts were active in the Roman world at once in 306: Italy, the lower Danube, Britain, Maximianus in Spain, and the Persian frontier; and only one emperor at Rome could dispose of all these resources at the same time, which was the root of the civil war.
people: 四個人的名字決定了306年的走向。馬克西米努斯·特拉克斯是個毫無世家背景的軍人，靠公元270年的兵變上位，執政後仍以嚴刑與不擇手段治國；305年他越過阿爾卑斯山進入高盧與西班牙劫掠，306年回師意大利，最終要證明自己對帝國的統治權。他犯下的致命錯誤發生在306年2月1日：他試圖把自己的兒子、凱撒馬克西米努斯升為奧古斯都並給予執政官銜，羅馬元老院在加利里烏斯的影響下拒絕承認這位年輕奧古斯都，馬克西米努斯當日便下令處死自己的兒子；軍隊隨即拒絕再向元老院所在的方向作戰，他與元老院、與意大利的關係自此全部斷裂。加利里烏斯是全場最清醒的棋手，他從叔父戴克里先手中接下帝國東半部，在303年與波斯訂立尼斯比斯和約之後一直留在東方經營，306年自敘利亞出發西征，途中把凱撒馬克西米安努斯升為奧古斯都，用以平衡君士坦提烏斯的晉升。他麾下兩位將領各懷心思：君士坦提烏斯·克洛魯斯被迫在不列顛與意大利之間奔馳，於306年7月25日在約克（埃博拉庫姆）病逝，軍隊當日便推戴他的兒子君士坦丁為奧古斯都；馬克西米安努斯則在意大利另立門戶，其子馬克森提烏斯於306年10月28日在羅馬自立為帝。最關鍵的一次行動發生在禁衛軍內部：馬克西米努斯的禁衛軍隊長普布利烏斯·科爾奈利烏斯·瓦列里烏斯在薩洛納的營中倒戈，馬克西米努斯死於自己人的刀下。城外則是薩珊的萬王之王沃洛加斯與其阿蘭盟友，率騎兵沿多瑙河下游的草原作戰，最終在薩瓦河與蒂薩河一連兩戰中敗於羅馬聯軍，轉為求和。
peopleEn: The names of four men decided the course of 306. Maximinus Thrax was a soldier with no aristocratic background who had risen through the coup of AD 270 and governed with severity and without scruple even after that; in 305 he crossed the Alps into Gaul and Spain to plunder, and in 306 he turned back into Italy, determined at last to establish his right to rule the empire. His fatal error came on 1 February 306: he tried to raise his own son, the Caesar Maximus, to the rank of Augustus and to a consulship, and the Roman Senate, under Galerius's influence, refused to recognise the young Augustus; Maximinus had his son killed the same day. The army then refused to advance any further towards the Senate, and from that day his relations with the Senate and with Italy were severed altogether. Galerius was the clearest-headed player on the board. He had taken over the eastern half of the empire from his uncle Diocletian, had remained in the East after the peace of Nisibis with Persia in 303, and set out west from Syria in 306, raising the Caesar Maximianus to the rank of Augustus on the way so as to balance the promotion of Constantius. The two subordinates under him were each bent on their own game: Constantius Chlorus was torn between Britain and Italy, and died at York (Eboracum) on 25 July 306, on which very day the army acclaimed his son Constantine as Augustus; Maximianus established a separate base in Italy, and his son Maxentius had himself crowned emperor at Rome on 28 October 306. The most decisive action took place inside the Praetorian Guard: Publius Cornelius Valerius, commander of Maximinus's guard, turned against him in the camp at Salona, and Maximinus was killed by his own men. Outside the walls stood Vologaes, the Sassanian King of Kings, and his Alan allies, campaigning with cavalry along the grasslands of the lower Danube, and they were finally beaten in two consecutive battles, on the Save and on the Tisza, and had to sue for terms.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓出自新亞述時期，約公元前八至七世紀，是角與木複合的短反曲弓，弓身前後都帶明顯的折角，亞述人把它用於乘車射擊與步兵齊射，有效射程常被描述為「百步」上下。它比這場戰爭早了一千零一年，在公元306年的歐洲不可能出現；卡牌借用的是弓這個類別，不是這件器物本身。但亞述長弓的技術譜系確實站在這場戰爭的戰場上。亞述弓的後裔是角筋複合反曲弓，薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭的騎手用的正是這種弓：短、硬、張力大，適合騎在馬上快速張弦與拋射，箭鏃多為窄身三棱鐵鏃，重量足以咬穿皮甲與鎖子甲的接縫。馬克西米努斯引入歐洲的正是這批人。羅馬一方同樣用弓：東方軍團中常設的弓手大隊（sagittarii）與騎兵弓手（equites sagittarii）配發的角筋複合弓，與薩爾馬提亞弓同源，晚出的軍團名錄裡還能讀到弓手一類單位的編制條目。羅馬步兵的其他裝備是：短劍配大曲面盾牌（橢圓形、沿縱軸微彎的scutum），鎧甲以分段甲與環鏈甲並行，頭盔是鐵條拼合的條形頭盔；長矛供軍團士兵使用，短標槍只給輕裝步兵；騎兵用較長的劍與小圓盾。攻城方面，羅馬人使用配重式投石機與弩砲以及攻城塔。戰馬、輜重車與糧秣車隊同樣關鍵；海路則靠禁衛軍艦隊沿地中海與亞得里亞海轉運。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card belongs to the Neo-Assyrian period, roughly the eighth to seventh century BC: a short recurve bow of horn and wood composite, with pronounced angular recurves at both ends, used by the Assyrians both for shooting from chariots and for massed volleys from infantry, with an effective range conventionally given as about a hundred paces. It stands a thousand and one years before this war and could not have existed in Europe in AD 306; what the card borrows is the class of the bow, not the artefact itself. Even so, the technical line of the Assyrian bow really does stand on the battlefield of this war. The descendant of the Assyrian bow is the horn-and-sinew composite reflex bow, and that is exactly what the Sarmatian and Alan riders used: short, stiff, of high tension, suited to being drawn quickly and loosed from the saddle, with narrow-bodied trilobate iron heads heavy enough to bite through the joins of leather and mail. Those were the people Maximinus brought into Europe. The Romans used bows as well: the bow units (sagittarii) and mounted bowmen (equites sagittarii) of the eastern army were equipped with horn-and-sinew composite bows of the same family as the Sarmatian bow, and the later army lists still carry entries for units of bowmen. The other equipment of the Roman infantry was: a short sword with a large curved shield (the oval scutum, slightly bent along its long axis); body armour in which segmented plate and chain mail were used side by side; helmets made of iron strips joined into a spangenhelm; a long pilum for legionary infantry, with short throwing javelins given only to light-armed troops; and for the cavalry a longer spatha and a small round shield. For siege work the Romans used counterweight artillery and ballistae together with siege towers. Horses, wagons and the baggage train mattered as much; and on the sea the Praetorian fleet carried supplies along the Mediterranean and the Adriatic.
tactics: 意大利戰線的攻防是三世紀末羅馬野戰的典型樣貌：軍隊行軍時以縱隊前進，車隊與糧秣居中，騎兵在兩翼警戒，宿營挖壕築柵。馬克西米努斯的軍隊在305年掃蕩高盧與西班牙之後，士氣與裝備都有耗損，306年春回師意大利時聯軍已從東方逼近，遂占據阿奎萊亞與維羅納一線。維羅納的守軍閉門不納，馬克西米努斯以強攻取之，軍隊在入城之後大肆劫掠，士氣卻因缺糧與疫病而崩解。聯軍方面，加利里烏斯與君士坦提烏斯率主力越過阿爾卑斯山，彼時可供大軍通過的山口有限，縱隊在山道上拉成細長的一串，後勤完全依賴沿山麓的補給線。卡農圖姆會戰發生在潘諾尼亞的開闊地帶，這是聯軍最能發揮騎兵優勢的場合：騎兵在步兵方陣兩翼反覆衝擊，馬克西米努斯的隊形一旦出現缺口，潰兵便被騎兵一路追擊到阿奎萊亞，圍城最終以禁衛軍倒戈收場。多瑙河戰線的作風不同。薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭的騎兵以大範圍游騎與襲擾著稱，靠的是分散與快速突進；羅馬聯軍的應對是以步兵大隊結成的密集方陣穩住河岸渡口，再用騎兵部隊逐次打散敵方散兵。306年9月的薩瓦河之戰與次年的蒂薩河之戰，羅軍都是用這種方式消耗掉對方的機動優勢，最後逼出求和。無論哪一線，羅馬人一貫的優勢是道路、營地與糧秣體系；蠻族援軍的優勢是速度與初期的兵力優勢。真正決定勝負的，是誰能在多瑙河與亞平寧山之間維持供給。
tacticsEn: The fighting on the Italian front followed the standard pattern of a late third century Roman field army: the column marched in order with the wagons and the provisions in the middle, cavalry out on both flanks, and the camp dug and palisaded each night. Maximinus's army, worn down after the sweep through Gaul and Spain in 305, was returning to Italy in the spring of 306 to find the coalition already approaching from the East, and took up a line at Aquileia and Verona. The garrison of Verona shut its gates against him, and Maximinus took the city by assault; once inside, the army plundered freely, and its morale collapsed instead under hunger and sickness. On the coalition side, Galerius and Constantius led the main body over the Alps, where few passes could take a great army, so that the column stretched into a thin thread on the mountain road and the whole of the logistics hung on the supply line along the foothills. The battle of Carnuntum was fought on the open ground of Pannonia, the place where the coalition could best use its cavalry: the horsemen charged repeatedly against the flanks of the infantry line, and once Maximinus's formation opened, the routed were chased by the cavalry all the way to Aquileia, and the siege of that city ended with the Praetorian Guard turning against its master. The Danube front worked differently. Sarmatian and Alan horsemen were famous for wide-ranging raiding and for relying on dispersion and sudden attacks; the Roman answer was to hold the river crossings with dense squares of auxiliary infantry and then to break the enemy's loose formations piecemeal with bodies of cavalry. Both the battle on the Save in September 306 and the following year's battle on the Tisza were won in that manner, and the coalition's advantage in mobility was worn away until terms were asked for. On either front the Roman strength was roads, camps and the supply system, and the barbarian strength was speed and a temporary edge in numbers. What decided the outcome was who could keep the supplies moving between the Danube and the Apennines.
data: 可引的數字大致如下。306年被稱為「四帝之年」，四位執政者分別是馬克西米努斯·特拉克斯、加利里烏斯、君士坦提烏斯·克洛魯斯與君士坦丁。關鍵日期：戴克里先於305年5月1日在尼科米底亞退位，馬克西米安努斯於同年7月20日退位；306年2月1日四位奧古斯都級別的晉升同時生效，馬克西米努斯同日處死自己的兒子；卡農圖姆之戰一般定於306年7月11日；馬克西米努斯在薩洛納被殺，編年史把日期繫於同年6月或7月，史料在戰敗與被殺的先後上並不一致；君士坦提烏斯於306年7月25日在約克病逝，同日軍隊推戴君士坦丁；馬克森提烏斯於306年10月28日在羅馬即位；薩瓦河之戰在306年9月，其後的蒂薩河之戰在次年。編制數字方面，晚期羅馬一個常備軍團約一千至一千二百人，一個輔助步兵大隊約五百人，一個騎兵大隊約五百人；戴克里先時期全帝國有三十個軍團，到306年前後已銳減至約二十五個，多瑙河與不列顛戰線的損失最為明顯。關於阿蘭與薩爾馬提亞援軍的規模，史料只給出「數萬」一類的概數，可靠的具體數字極少；有後世記載稱約五千名薩爾馬提亞騎兵被調往不列顛，並有大批薩爾馬提亞人被安置在潘諾尼亞的墾區，兩說的年份都落在306年前後。地理上，卡農圖姆到阿奎萊亞沿軍用道路約四百公里，阿奎萊亞到薩洛納約三百五十至四百公里，薩瓦河到蒂薩河約二百五十公里；從306年春天聯軍進軍到七月會戰，意大利戰線歷時約四到五個月。武器方面，亞述長弓一類的複合反曲弓有效射程約在四百至五百米量級，羅馬弩砲的射程同樣在數百米上下，具體數字各書不一。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The year 306 is known as the year of the four emperors, and the four rulers were Maximinus Thrax, Galerius, Constantius Chlorus and Constantine. The key dates: Diocletian abdicated at Nicomedia on 1 May 305, and Maximian abdicated on 20 July of the same year; on 1 February 306 the four promotions to the rank of Augustus took effect together, and Maximinus killed his son on that same day; the battle of Carnuntum is generally dated 11 July 306; Maximinus was killed at Salona, and the chronicles tie the date to June or July of the same year, the sources not agreeing on whether the defeat came before the murder; Constantius died at York on 25 July 306, and the army acclaimed Constantine on the same day; Maxentius was crowned at Rome on 28 October 306; the battle on the Save fell in September 306 and the battle on the Tisza in the year after. On organisation: a late Roman legion held roughly one thousand to one thousand two hundred men, an auxiliary infantry cohort about five hundred, and a cavalry ala about five hundred; under Diocletian the empire had thirty legions, and by about 306 these had been cut to roughly twenty-five, with the heaviest losses on the Danube and in Britain. As for the scale of the Alan and Sarmatian auxiliaries, the sources give only vague figures of tens of thousands, and firm numbers are extremely rare; later accounts speak of about five thousand Sarmatian horsemen transferred to Britain, and of large numbers of Sarmatians settled in the districts of Pannonia, and both statements are dated to around 306. Geographically, the military road from Carnuntum to Aquileia runs about four hundred kilometres, Aquileia to Salona about three hundred and fifty to four hundred, and the Save to the Tisza about two hundred and fifty; from the coalition's advance in the spring of 306 to the battle in July, the Italian front ran for some four to five months. As for weapons, composite reflex bows of the Assyrian type have an effective range of roughly four hundred to five hundred metres, and Roman ballistae reached a comparable several hundred metres, the exact figures varying from one book to another.
cause: 這場內戰的直接引爆點是306年2月1日那場繼承危機。戴克里先與馬克西米安努斯在305年相繼退位，留下的體制有兩個致命弱點：每位奧古斯都都有為期二十年的統治期限與「自動退位」的傳統設計，而退位並不終結權力競爭，只是把它轉給另一批人；同時帝國的資源被切成兩份，每個奧古斯都只握有半個帝國的野戰軍與稅源，任何一方要壓倒另一方，就必須先贏得對方疆域內軍隊與元老院的忠誠。馬克西米努斯尤其急迫。他沒有顯赫家世，靠政變與嚴刑立威，執政後又把大量兵源與財政壓在軍隊上，卻始終缺乏帝國傳統精英的認可，需要一個直接的合法性來源；於是他把兒子立為奧古斯都。元老院在加利里烏斯一方影響下不承認，這等於宣告他無法統治羅馬的核心政治體。兒子被殺之後，元老院與禁衛軍都與他決裂，他只剩下軍隊這一樣東西，而軍隊不願替一個已被元老院拒絕的人去對付元老。第二層原因是邊疆形勢。經過三世紀的邊境戰爭，萊茵、多瑙河與不列顛前線早已被削薄，意大利本土的防衛空虛到馬克西米努斯可以長驅直入。而馬克西米努斯在北疆的困境又逼他引外族為援：薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭人被請過多瑙河，薩珊的沃洛加斯也介入。短期看這解決了兵源問題，長期看卻把帝國的安全押在外族的意願上，並給了元老院與其他奧古斯都「勾結蠻族」的說法——這正是後世史家判定這場戰爭為羅馬衰敗之始的原因之一。
causeEn: The direct trigger was the succession crisis of 1 February 306. When Diocletian and Maximian abdicated in 305, the system they left behind had two fatal weaknesses: every Augustus carried a fixed twenty-year term and a tradition of automatic retirement, and retirement did not end the competition for power, it merely handed it to another set of men; and the resources of the empire were cut in half, so that each Augustus held only half of the field army and half of the tax revenue, and anyone who wished to crush the other had first to win over the troops and the Senate inside his rival's provinces. Maximinus was the more desperate of the two. He had no distinguished family, had risen on a coup and on severity, and had piled men and money into the army while never securing the recognition of the traditional elites of the empire; he needed a direct source of legitimacy, and so he made his son an Augustus. The Senate, under Galerius's influence, refused to recognise him, which was in effect a public statement that he could not rule the central political body of Rome. After his son was killed, both the Senate and the Praetorian Guard broke with him, leaving him nothing but the army — and the army was unwilling to fight for a man the Senate had already rejected against the Senate. A second cause lay in the frontier situation. After three centuries of frontier wars, the Rhine, the Danube and the British line had all been thinned out, and the defence of Italy itself was hollow enough for Maximinus to drive straight in. The pressure on Maximinus in the north then forced him to call in outsiders: the Sarmatians and the Alan crossed the Danube at his invitation, and Vologaes of Persia intervened as well. In the short term this solved the problem of manning the army; in the long term it staked the empire's security on the good will of outsiders, and it handed the Senate and the other Augusti the charge of conspiring with the barbarians — one of the reasons later historians treat this war as a beginning of Rome's decline.
impact: 306年在政治上是一個轉折點。馬克西米努斯一死，他控制的意大利與羅馬落到馬克西米安努斯與其子馬克森提烏斯手中；不列顛與高盧隨著君士坦提烏斯的死歸了君士坦丁；東方則仍歸加利里烏斯。帝國從此不再是兩位奧古斯都分治的整體，而是三方乃至更多方各自為政，接下來五年的局面——308年卡爾斯堪特烏姆與安拉河的敗績、310年馬克西米安努斯父子下野、312年米利維安橋之戰、324年君士坦丁的最終一役——都由此展開。制度上的變化更為深遠。軍隊推立皇帝的做法在這幾年裡被固定下來：士兵在元老院之外宣示效忠的對象，皇帝合法性越來越依賴軍隊的承認，禁衛軍則成為決定皇帝生死的關鍵角色，四帝共治的經驗最終導向324年後的單一皇帝統治與帝國的重新編組。此外，薩爾馬提亞人被整批安置在潘諾尼亞，部分騎兵調往不列顛，晚期羅馬軍隊中蠻族成分的比例持續上升；宗教政策也走到轉折點，306年仍在迫害基督徒，311年加利里烏斯在塞撒洛尼卡頒布容忍詔令，313年君士坦丁與李錫尼的米蘭敕令隨之而來。多瑙河線的勝利同樣重要：薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭聯軍在薩瓦河與蒂薩河被擊敗後，多瑙河中下游重新回到羅馬控制之下，這條防線又撐了三十多年，直到四世紀中葉才真正崩潰。
impactEn: Politically, 306 was a turning point. With the death of Maximinus, the Italy and Rome he had controlled passed to Maximianus and to his son Maxentius; Britain and Gaul, with the death of Constantius, passed to Constantine; and the East remained with Galerius. The empire was from then on no longer a whole divided between two Augusti, but a patchwork in which three parties or more each ruled their own ground, and the whole shape of the following five years — the defeats of Carnuntum and the Argaeus in 308, the deposition of Maximianus and his son in 310, the battle of the Milvian Bridge in 312, and Constantine's final campaign in 324 — grew out of it. The institutional change was deeper. The practice of the army raising emperors was fixed in place over these years: the soldiers declared their loyalty to a candidate in defiance of the Senate, an emperor's legitimacy increasingly rested on the army's acknowledgement, and the Praetorian Guard became the decisive arbiter of an emperor's life, while the experience of the Tetrarchy led in the end to the single emperorship after 324 and the reorganisation of the empire. The Sarmatians were also settled in Pannonia in whole communities and some of their horsemen were transferred to Britain, so that the barbarian element in late Roman troops continued to grow; and religious policy reached a turning point, with the persecution of Christians still under way in 306, the toleration edict of Galerius at Serdica in 311, and the Milan agreement between Constantine and Licinius following in 313. The victory on the Danube mattered as much: after the Sarmatian and Alan coalition was beaten on the Save and on the Tisza, the middle and lower Danube returned to Roman control, and that line held for another thirty years before it truly collapsed in the middle of the fourth century.
result: 就306年這一年而言，結果是明確的：馬克西米努斯·特拉克斯在薩洛納死於自己人的刀下，他試圖建立的奧古斯都世襲帝國只維持了幾個月；卡農圖姆之戰決定了意大利的歸屬，聯軍占領阿奎萊亞並把馬克西米努斯的殘部逐向亞得里亞海岸；禁衛軍在最後關頭倒戈，使這場戰役以一次宮廷刺殺收場，而不是一場漫長的攻城。多瑙河方面，薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭人先在薩瓦河敗退、次年在蒂薩河再敗，被迫求和並接受定居安排；不列顛方面，君士坦提烏斯在籌備下一次北進時病逝於約克，軍隊在同日推戴君士坦丁。因此這場被稱為「四帝內戰」的衝突，實際結果是分裂而非統一：沒有任何一方能吞下整個帝國，戰爭的成果是意大利、多瑙河與不列顛三塊地盤分屬三支軍系，帝國的統一要等到324年才由君士坦丁完成。對裝備與編制而言，這一年也有實質推進：薩爾馬提亞與阿蘭騎兵帶著角筋複合反曲弓進入帝國的防務體系，羅馬的弓手大隊與騎兵弓手在多瑙河線上得到更重要的位置，常備野戰軍的規模與騎兵比例都在上升；而禁衛軍的權力膨脹到足以廢立皇帝的程度，這種平衡最終在313年君士坦丁與李錫尼之間重演，並在324年被徹底打破。
resultEn: For the year 306 itself the outcome is clear: Maximinus Thrax was killed by his own men at Salona, and the hereditary Augustan dynasty he had tried to build lasted only a few months; the battle of Carnuntum settled the fate of Italy, the coalition occupied Aquileia and drove Maximinus's remnants down towards the Adriatic coast; and the turning of the Praetorian Guard at the last moment ended the campaign with a palace murder rather than a protracted siege. On the Danube, the Sarmatians and the Alan were beaten back first on the Save and then on the Tisza, and were forced to ask for terms and to accept a settlement on the land; in Britain, Constantius died of illness at York while preparing his next northern advance, and the army acclaimed Constantine on the same day. The conflict therefore known as the war of the four emperors ended in division rather than in unity: no single party swallowed the whole empire, and its outcome was that Italy, the Danube and Britain fell to three separate military factions, with the reunification of the empire reserved for Constantine in 324. For equipment and organisation the year also marked real progress: Sarmatian and Alan riders carried their horn-and-sinew composite reflex bows into the defensive system of the empire, the Roman bow units and mounted bowmen gained a more important place on the Danube line, and the size of the permanent field armies and the proportion of cavalry in them both rose. The power of the Praetorian Guard, meanwhile, grew until it could make and unmake emperors; that balance was played out once more between Constantine and Licinius in 313, and broken for good in 324.
